app.tagline: Host a Minecraft server for your friends, no command line needed.

soon.title: Coming soon
soon.description: This page is being built and will arrive in a coming MineHost release.

quit.title: Quit MineHost?
quit.body_one: {{count}} server is running. Stop it safely and quit?
quit.body_other: {{count}} servers are running. Stop them all safely and quit?
quit.done: MineHost has shut down. You can close this tab; start MineHost again when you need it.

servers.heading: Your servers
servers.emptyDescription: Set up a Paper server in a few minutes. MineHost downloads Java and everything else for you.
servers.name: Name

wizard.title: Create server
wizard.versionHint: Your friends need this exact version to join.
wizard.noVersions: Paper has no stable version yet. Please try again later.
wizard.name: Server name
wizard.nameHint: Friends also see this name in Minecraft's server list.
wizard.nameInvalid: The name must be 1 to 64 characters long.
wizard.memoryHint: More players or plugins need more RAM.
wizard.memoryWarning: Only {{free}} of RAM is free. The server will run, but your computer may slow down.
wizard.portHint: Leave empty and MineHost picks a free port, starting at 25565.
wizard.portInvalid: The port must be a number from 1024 to 65535.
wizard.creatingDescription: The first time can take a few minutes because MineHost needs to download Java.

server.killBody: The server stops immediately without saving. Players may lose what they did in the last few minutes.
server.restartPending: The server will start again in a few seconds.
server.slowStart: The server has been starting for over 5 minutes. Check the console to see what it is doing.

broken.title: This server cannot be read
broken.missing_instance: The server folder has no instance.toml file.
broken.newer_schema: This server was created by a newer MineHost. Please update MineHost.
broken.id_mismatch: The ID in instance.toml ({{found}}) does not match the folder name. The folder may have been copied by hand.

crashHints.NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY: The server ran out of RAM. Give it more RAM on the Server settings page.
crashHints.WRONG_JAVA: The server needs a different Java version. This is a MineHost bug, please report it.
crashHints.PORT_IN_USE: Another program is using the server's port. Change the port on the Server settings page.
crashHints.EULA_NOT_ACCEPTED: Accept the Minecraft EULA, then start the server again.
crashHints.GAME_ERROR: The game or a plugin failed. Check the console for details, then try restarting.
crashHints.unknown: The cause is unknown. Check the console for details.

eula.title: Minecraft End User License Agreement
eula.body: Minecraft requires you to accept Mojang's End User License Agreement (EULA) before running a server.

console.label: Server log
console.placeholder: Type a command and press Enter, e.g. say hello
console.offline: Start the server to send commands

game.advancedHint: Every key in server.properties. Change the port on the Server settings page.
game.empty: server.properties has no keys yet. Start the server once so Minecraft fills it in.
game.restartNote: Takes effect after the server restarts.

fields.pvp: Allow players to fight each other (PvP)

hints.motd: Shown under the server name in Minecraft's server list.
hints.white-list: Add players with the command whitelist add <name> in the console.
hints.online-mode: When off, anyone can join with any name, including someone else's.

settings.title: Server settings
settings.autostartHint: The server runs every time MineHost starts.
settings.restartOnCrashHint: Tries up to 3 times within 10 minutes.

delete.title: Delete server
delete.description: The server folder moves to MineHost's trash and can be restored by hand.
delete.stopFirst: Stop the server before deleting it.
delete.confirmBody: The server disappears from MineHost. The world and files stay in MineHost's trash/ folder.
delete.done: The server was moved to the trash

ui.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. See the MineHost log file for details.
errors.NETWORK: Cannot reach MineHost. Check that MineHost is still running.
errors.PLAYER_NOT_FOUND: No Minecraft account has this name.
errors.PATH_OUTSIDE_ROOT: The path is outside the allowed folder.
errors.PORT_IN_USE: Port {{port}} is used by another program.
errors.SERVER_BUSY: The server is busy and cannot do this right now.
errors.EULA_NOT_ACCEPTED: You need to accept the Minecraft EULA before starting the server.
errors.VERSION_NOT_FOUND: This Minecraft version was not found.
errors.NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot reach the Internet. Check your connection and try again.
errors.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The download failed partway. Please try again.
errors.CHECKSUM_MISMATCH: The downloaded file is damaged. Please try again.
errors.BACKUP_CORRUPT: The backup is damaged or its checksum does not match.
errors.JAVA_INSTALL_FAILED: Could not install Java. Please try again.
errors.NOT_ENOUGH_DISK: Less than 1 GB of disk space is free. Free up some space and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: The request was refused because it did not come from the MineHost page on this computer.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_BY_VERSION: This Minecraft version does not support this action.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than allowed.
errors.FILE_NOT_TEXT: This file is not valid UTF-8 text.
errors.FILE_CHANGED: The file changed since it was opened. Reload the latest version.
errors.FILE_EXISTS: A file or folder with that name already exists.

jobsPage.description: What MineHost is doing or just finished, such as creating a server or making a backup.
jobsPage.emptyHint: Tasks show up here when you create a server or make a backup.

overview.offline: The server is stopped. Start it to see CPU and RAM.
